notes.title: Update "SphereRun"
notes.content: The new update for CubeRun "SphereRun" is finally here. Do you have what it takes to complete the levels?

notes.title: New update with 15 new levels
notes.content:
The new update for CubeRun are now live. 15 brand new levels and 5 new achievements. The themes for the new levels are "Dreamhack", "Nightcore" and "Drum and Bass". 

CubeRun a challenging game with 60 levels and 25 Achievements. 
Can you beat them all.

notes.title: New Update 03/28

Added Level Select

Achievements can't be earned through the level selection
All coins are removed when you play a level through the level selection
